Review of UV model with `hkg-angle-steering-2025` on 2025 Ioniq 5.
* It feels like the model is trying to steer smoothly but it often ends up understeering following by a more abrupt correction. It sometimes does this several times in a row.
* Overall it feels unresponsive. Turns feel "late". Especially scary on local roads.
* Highway speeds are mostly OK but it can't be depended upon. Sometimes it decided to just nope out and drift left across the left line.
